Can a former salaryman become peerless in another world?!

A salaryman was shot to death just before earning a promotion, and a god decided to reincarnate him in another world as a fifteen-year-old healer named Luciel. The day-to-day life of a super-masochistic, back-from-the-dead healer begins, with his very survival on the line!

Kentaro Miura's legendary series returns in Berserk: The Golden Age Arc - Memorial Edition.

The lone mercenary Guts travels a land where a century-old war is raging. His ferocity and skill in battle attract the attention of Griffith, the leader of a group of mercenaries called the Band of the Hawk. Guts becomes Griffith’s closest ally and confidant, but despite all their victories, Guts begins to question why he fights for another man’s dream of ruling his own kingdom. Unknown to Guts, Griffith’s unyielding ambition is about to bestow a horrible fate on them both.

Touka Minamori is a college student at a university in Tokyo. Although she has a model-like style and good looks that turn heads, she is a hard-core loner who is not good at socializing. Then a younger childhood friend, Kokoha, appears in front of her. To her surprise, she turns out to be the magical girl Tearheart. She then invites Touka to join her as a magical girl. But Touka immediately rejects the offer.

"Because I'm a college student......!?"

Despite her refusal, Touka reluctantly accepts to become a "magical college girl" after being pushed aside by Kokoha. During the transformation, she is exposed in the nude, is called a "lascivious woman" on the streets, and is even attacked by the enemy monsters. What is the future of Crystear, the new magical college girl?

Magical girls are out of fashion! The era of the magical college girl with a sexy and erotic body has arrived!

Meng Qi is a time traveler who always wants to be a charming swordsman in white. 155971.description:
"If they have no water, then let them drink milk."

Before becoming a manga author, Hiromu Arakawa was a farmer for seven years in Hokkaido. She raised cows, grew vegetables, feared bears and got jerked around by squirrels! She worked all year long from morning to night without any breaks - and it was tough! If you read the manga, you'll understand. Farmers are cool!! The author of Fullmetal Alchemist presents her life of blood, sweat and laughter in comic (and now in anime) form!!

155303.description: 15 years ago, an eerie catastrophe struck Luofeng City, reducing it to a lifeless ruin overnight. Ding Xiao—once hailed as a prodigy for forming his spirit embryo at the age of seven—joined the Spirit Suppression Sect, only to fall from grace after shattering his own embryo. Cast out, he was forced to serve as a coffin bearer in the Guibu Division, enduring five long years of hardship and scorn. Against all odds, he awakened his power anew, stunning everyone during the Sect's advancement trials and rising as a force to be reckoned with—a growing threat to the Lingbu Division. Nowadays, as sinister omens spread and supernatural threats loomed, Ding Xiao embarked on a perilous quest to save his ailing sister. But the path ahead drew him into a web of power struggles and hidden truths. As the tragedy of Luofeng City gradually came to light, he discovered that his fate was bound inseparably to the destiny of the spirits themselves.....
